clause_2_reward_misalignment.clause: if two consecutive checkpoints show zero new TRAINING wins in the run's training_status.json while eval score rises, the run is stopped as reward-misaligned
clause_2_reward_misalignment.rationale: this is the lesson of the predecessor's stall (macro-ppo-jungle1, s99081683: training wins frozen at 16 over 1,700+ episodes while the policy fired 36-40 shots/episode and farmed score): a policy that gets better at scoring without winning is optimizing the shaping, not the objective. Run 3 self-polices by encoding the stall signature as a stop condition rather than waiting for a human to notice it.

trainer_v2.reward_alignment: cap lowered 10.0 -> 1.0 (the ONLY reward delta from the predecessor). SPEEDRUN objective: score shaping is a discovery aid only and must never rival the +10 win bonus. Under the predecessor's cap of 10.0, a shaped truncation return could approach a win's return, and the predecessor duly farmed score without finishing (training wins frozen at 16 over 1,700+ episodes at 36-40 shots/episode). Under 1.0, the max shaped truncation return is ~= 1.0 minus the time penalty, far below the worst-case win return of ~= 8.6 (win +10, plus at most +1.0 shaping, minus 24000 ticks x 0.0001 time penalty = 2.4), so finishing strictly dominates farming everywhere in return space.
trainer_v2.discounting_note: gamma applies PER MACRO STEP; the macro reward is the undiscounted per-tick sum over the ticks the macro consumed (~20-70), so 0.999 per macro is roughly 0.999^(1/40) per native tick; truncation is reward-neutral (v2 wrapper), so 24000-tick late-level truncations bootstrap instead of paying -10

success_criteria_tiers.scope_note: all tiers are STUDENT_ONLY autonomous outcomes on engineering-seed evals of Jungle1; teacher-assisted or recovery-mode wins count for nothing here. SPEEDRUN objective: success is win rate first, then median winning ticks; SCORE IS EXPLICITLY NOT A SUCCESS METRIC at any tier (it appears in telemetry only as a liveness diagnostic)
success_criteria_tiers.tier_0_sanity: wrapper fidelity holds under the trained policy: shots_on_target_rate >= 0.95 on every eval, and the policy fires at >= 0.5x the teacher's macro fire rate (the BC init fires ~20x too rarely; PPO must at least not collapse further)
success_criteria_tiers.tier_1_signal: any autonomous Jungle1 win at any checkpoint
success_criteria_tiers.tier_2_promising: win rate >= 50% over the 8-seed Jungle1 eval of the best checkpoint
success_criteria_tiers.tier_3_strong: median winning ticks over the 8-seed eval of the best checkpoint <= 1.5x the teacher-through-macro Jungle1 time: 12-panel teacher ceiling probe teacher12 (s99081678) won Jungle1 in 3134 native ticks (completion sha256:2c4962716d40f4ec7d1111b45252f20514fc80ba7c6118303ea7cf0267bd6d7f), so the threshold is 4701 ticks

success_criteria_tiers.failure_is_reportable: if tier 1 is not reached, the run is reported as FAIL with the full eval telemetry; no re-slicing after the fact
